Latin word

sequor

sequor, sequī, secūtus sum

verb, third conjugation, deponent

follow, go or come after; follow (a guide, advice, an example); follow, strive for

In this lexicon

  • follow

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Rud. 184b–c: Sequere mē hāc ergō. — Sequor.; Sen. Ep. 107.8: noctem diēs sequitur

  • follow

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Sen. 5: nātūram optimam ducem tamquam deum sequimur; Cic. Fam. 4.3.2 (Lewis & Short: auctōritātem et cōnsilium alicujus)

  • pursue

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. Ep. 1.1.72: nec sequar aut fugiam, quae dīligit ipse vel ōdit (Lewis & Short); Cic. Mur. 55: ōtium ac tranquillitātem vītae (Lewis & Short)
